feedback: Written before this candidate races. The candidate is the ±0.03 m, 16 mm, y = 0.04 row, which is the best-raced geometry (iteration 3, 69.46, reproduced in iteration 5). I am restoring the controller that produced it (kp 1.2, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.1). Iteration 4 (61.49) changed kp to 1.0 and widened the row to ±0.04 m in the same race. Progress fell on the s-bend (0.210 to 0.160) and oval (0.184 to 0.170), and line loss stayed at 1.0 per run, so the gain change is the more likely cause. The ±0.04 m row has therefore not been tested at kp 1.2 on its own. Line loss persists at 1.0 to 1.1 events per run and max error sits near 0.062 m on every track, so the 0.06 m off-track limit is still the binding failure. Do not expect a new best score from this candidate. It is a confirmation race.
requested_changes: Next iteration, race the ±0.04 m row at 16 mm with y = 0.04 at kp 1.2 and kd 0.4. This isolates the widening from the gain change that confounded iteration 4.

If the ±0.04 m row at kp 1.2 still gives line loss of 1.0 or more per run, test a 12 mm footprint at the same ±0.04 m spacing, to check whether 16 mm edge noise adds s-bend oscillation (iteration 3 s-bend oscillation was 0.168).
Keep y = 0.04 unless slalom steering oscillation reaches 0.15 or more. It has stayed at 0.145 to 0.147 across all row tests so far.
